summary: This Form 8-K reports Yorkville International Capital Corp.'s consummation of its initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option, for gross proceeds of $230,000,000. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The Cayman Islands blank-check company entered into an underwriting agreement with Cohen Company Capital Markets, a warrant agreement, an investment management trust agreement, a registration rights agreement, and private placement warrants purchase agreements with its sponsor and underwriter. The trust structure and warrant mechanics are standard SPAC terms. What to watch: the timeline for identifying a de-SPAC business combination target.
